comment: Tunsil (triceps) is progressing well in his recovery but is not expected to return by the end of the 2026 regular season, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

name: Colson Yankoff
comment: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

name: Luke McCaffrey
comment: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

name: Jeremy Reaves
comment: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

name: Nick Cross
comment: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).
